title: product.template to product.product — attribute/variant explosion

always.behaviour: All combinations pre-generated via itertools.product Cartesian product when ptal is saved

dynamic.behaviour: No pre-generation; variant created on-demand by _create_product_variant when added to a sales order
dynamic.trigger: has_dynamic_attributes() returns True, pre-generation loop is skipped

no_variant.behaviour: Attribute excluded from Cartesian product; ptav exists but no product.product is generated for that dimension

single_value_optimisation.behaviour: Single-value lines are written directly onto existing variants rather than triggering full regeneration

variant_creation_trigger_chain: _create_variant_ids computes Cartesian product, creates Product.create(variants_to_create), calls _unlink_or_archive on surplus

combination_indices.uniqueness: partial unique index on (product_tmpl_id, combination_indices) WHERE active IS TRUE (product_product.py:121)

archived_variant_behaviour.non_dynamic: archived variant makes combination impossible (_is_combination_possible returns False at line 1167)
archived_variant_behaviour.dynamic: archived variant also makes combination impossible at line 1163; _create_product_variant can reactivate if combination is still possible (line 1226)

no_variant_on_physical_record.note: combination._without_no_variant_attributes().ids used when creating variant — no_variant ptav IDs never stored on product.product

awt_items.description: Verify that _create_variant_ids is called after every ptal write in a live Odoo session with always-mode attribute
awt_items.reason: runtime observation needed to confirm context flag interactions

awt_items.description: Verify price_extra sum on variant record when multiple attributes each carry non-zero extra prices
awt_items.reason: runtime observation to confirm summing behaviour across multi-attribute combinations

awt_items.description: Verify that no_variant ptav IDs are absent from combination_indices on a saved variant

migration_risk_notes: Variant limit (default 1000) may block migration of products with many attribute combinations; verify or raise the limit before migrating product templates
Changing create_variant mode after initial use is blocked; any mode changes must happen before products are created in the target instance
Archived variants are not deleted; they accumulate in product_product and may inflate record counts in the migrated database
combination_indices is a stored computed field; it must be recomputed after any bulk import of product_variant_combination rows
The partial unique index on combination_indices WHERE active IS TRUE means duplicate active variants for the same combination will cause constraint violations on bulk import
